dialogues.speaker: Shyam
dialogues.text: I was elected by the local residents... Um... I'm sort of a sheriff.

dialogues.speaker: Shyam
dialogues.text: They probably called me in to keep order because I used to be a mercenary in the Eremites. I've done many... jobs for them.

dialogues.speaker: Shyam
dialogues.text: I am indeed up to the task, so if you need help, go ahead and ask.

dialogues.speaker: Shyam
dialogues.text: But if you want to cause any trouble on my watch, you'd better think twice.
